en_title: Chris Pratt Says He 'Would Love' James Gunn to Return for Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 4 After Leaving DC
cn_title: 克里斯·帕拉特称「很乐意」让詹姆斯·古恩在离开DC后回归执导《银河护卫队4》
opus_summary: 詹姆斯·古恩宣布将离开DC影业后，克里斯·帕拉特表示，希望与他再次合作拍摄《银河护卫队4》。帕拉特称赞古恩执导了该系列全部三部电影，并说如果古恩愿意回归，他会很乐意。帕拉特此前还表示，漫威影业正在筹划让星爵回归。

paragraphs.en: Chris Pratt said he would love to reunite with James Gunn for Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 4 after the director abruptly announced he would be leaving DC Studios earlier this week.
paragraphs.cn: 在詹姆斯·古恩本周早些时候突然宣布将离开DC Studios后，克里斯·帕拉特表示，他很乐意与这位导演重聚，共同制作《银河护卫队4》。

paragraphs.en: Gunn is no longer running DC movies with Peter Safran – so what comes next? That's the question many comic book fans are asking as the dust begins to settle at Skydance, and although it will be quite a while before we actually see what happens, some are getting their hopes up for a Marvel reunion.
paragraphs.cn: 古恩不再与彼得·萨弗兰共同掌管DC电影——那么接下来会怎样？随着Skydance的风波开始平息，许多漫画迷都在问这个问题。虽然我们还要过相当长一段时间才能真正看到事情的发展，但有些人已经开始期待他与Marvel重聚。

paragraphs.en: Gunn directed three Guardians of the Galaxy movies for the Marvel Cinematic Universe (and dealt with his fair share of drama ) while working with the Marvel Studios team before leaving to help head up DC Studios in 2022 . Work on Man of Tomorrow and one other mystery DC project aside , the comic book movie maker's future is wide open. Chris Pratt, who has starred as the MCU's Star-Lord for more than a decade, told Moviezine it would be "awesome" to re-team with Gunn for Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 4 now that DC is about nearly in the rearview mirror.
paragraphs.cn: 古恩在与漫威影业团队合作期间，为漫威电影宇宙执导了三部《银河护卫队》电影（也经历了不少风波），随后于2022年离开，协助掌管DC Studios。除了《Man of Tomorrow》和另一个神秘DC项目的工作之外，这位漫画电影导演的未来充满可能。十多年来一直在漫威电影宇宙中饰演星爵的克里斯·帕拉特告诉Moviezine，如今DC几乎已成为过去，如果能在《银河护卫队4》中与古恩再度合作，那将「太棒了」。

paragraphs.en: "That would be awesome. I love working with James. He's the man," Pratt said. "I haven't had a chance to speak with him since that news came out yesterday."
paragraphs.cn: 「那太棒了。我喜欢和詹姆斯合作。他是个了不起的人，」帕拉特说，「自从昨天那个消息传出来后，我还没有机会和他聊聊。」

paragraphs.en: The last time we saw Star-Lord and the rest of the Guardians was in 2023's Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 . Although that story fit well as a bookend for its characters and Gunn's work on the franchise, fans have had a hard time letting go of some of the MCU's most popular faces – Pratt included.
paragraphs.cn: 我们上一次看到星爵和其他护卫队成员是在2023年的《银河护卫队3》中。虽然那个故事很好地为这些角色以及古恩在该系列中的工作画上了句号，但粉丝们一直难以舍弃漫威电影宇宙中一些最受欢迎的面孔——帕拉特也是如此。

paragraphs.en: In January of this year, the actor said he has a "really strong vision" to bring Star-Lord back in future MCU installments. Just last month, he promised that plans for his return were in the works at Marvel Studios . Gamora actor Zoe Saldaña also said in 2024 that "it would be a huge loss" if the space-traveling heroes were left behind .
paragraphs.cn: 今年1月，这位演员表示，他对让星爵在未来的漫威电影宇宙作品中回归有着「非常强烈的构想」。就在上个月，他保证漫威影业正在制定让他回归的计划。卡魔拉的扮演者佐伊·索尔达娜也在2024年表示，如果这些遨游太空的英雄被抛在一边，「那将是一个巨大的损失」。

paragraphs.en: Gunn coming back to Marvel again feels like a long shot, and it's always possible that we could see the Guardians return in another MCU ensemble film like next year's Avengers: Secret Wars . At least for now, Pratt is willing to hold out hope.
paragraphs.cn: 古恩再次回到Marvel似乎希望渺茫，而我们也始终有可能看到护卫队在另一部漫威电影宇宙群像电影中回归，比如明年的《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》。至少目前，帕拉特愿意继续抱有希望。

paragraphs.en: "All I'll say is, I love James," he added. "He directed all three [Guardians of the Galaxy movies], and that's pretty rare in those types of trilogies, to have the same director through all three. If he wanted to come back and bring it back, man. I would love that."
paragraphs.cn: 「我只想说，我喜欢詹姆斯，」他补充道，「他执导了全部三部《银河护卫队》电影，而在这类三部曲中，三部都由同一位导演执导是相当罕见的。如果他想回归，让这个系列重现的话，天哪，我会非常乐意。」

paragraphs.en: Whether it's with the MCU or DC, much of the future is a mystery. In Gunn's case, we at least know Skydance has yet to even see his cut of Man of Tomorrow after the director squashed rumors claiming otherwise last night. We'll know about what's coming down the pipe for Marvel when Avengers: Doomsday arrives next month.
paragraphs.cn: 无论是漫威电影宇宙还是DC，未来的许多事情都还是未知数。就古恩而言，在这位导演昨晚驳斥了与此相反的传闻后，我们至少知道Skydance甚至还没有看过他剪辑的《Man of Tomorrow》版本。等到《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》下个月上映时，我们就会知道Marvel接下来有什么计划。
